article_title: Trump's Nvidia intervention ties his political fortunes to the AI boom
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level C; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What central argument does the article make about Trump's intervention in Nvidia?
options: It separates Trump from both Nvidia and the wider AI economy
It ties Trump's political reputation more closely to Nvidia, Huang and the uncertain AI boom
It guarantees that congressional investigations will end
It shows that AI investment no longer affects US stock markets
tasks.correct_answer: It ties Trump's political reputation more closely to Nvidia, Huang and the uncertain AI boom
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הטענה המרכזית היא שהתערבות טראמפ קושרת את עתידו הפוליטי לחואנג, ל־Nvidia ולשגשוג הלא־ודאי של הבינה המלאכותית.

tasks.prompt: What oversight action are lawmakers considering?
options: A ban on all data centres in the United States
A vote to nationalise Nvidia immediately
Subpoenas and compelled testimony about possible access by China to advanced chips
A public inquiry into European mini-cars
tasks.correct_answer: Subpoenas and compelled testimony about possible access by China to advanced chips
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מחוקקים שוקלים זימונים ועדויות כפויות כדי לבדוק אם סין קיבלה גישה לטכנולוגיית שבבים מתקדמת.

tasks.prompt: Why could new revelations about Huang also harm Trump?
options: Trump publicly claimed credit for the deal and helped restore Huang, linking their reputations
Trump sold every share he owned before the dispute
Huang is running against Trump in an election
Congress has already cleared both men of wrongdoing
tasks.correct_answer: Trump publicly claimed credit for the deal and helped restore Huang, linking their reputations
tasks.explanation_hebrew: טראמפ נטל קרדיט פומבי והיה מעורב בהחזרת חואנג, ולכן מידע מזיק חדש עלול לפגוע גם בו.

tasks.prompt: What does “inextricably linked” mean in the article?
options: Connected only by a short-term contract
Separated by opposing political goals
Mentioned together by accident
Connected so closely that they are difficult to separate
tasks.correct_answer: Connected so closely that they are difficult to separate
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר קשר הדוק כל כך שקשה להפריד בין גורלותיהם של טראמפ וחואנג.

tasks.prompt: What political division inside Trump's administration does the article describe?
options: Scott Bessent and Howard Lutnick disagreed over restrictions on AI-chip exports
JD Vance and Tom Cotton disagreed over motorway speed limits
The Treasury and Congress agreed to end all chip exports
Democrats divided over whether Huang founded Nvidia
tasks.correct_answer: Scott Bessent and Howard Lutnick disagreed over restrictions on AI-chip exports
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת עימות בין סקוט בסנט להווארד לוטניק בשאלת הגבלות יצוא שבבי AI.

tasks.prompt: How sharply had Nvidia's stock fallen before Trump's intervention?
options: About 8.6% over several years
Exactly 10% in a single hour
More than 32% over several weeks, including 14% on the previous Friday
It had risen continuously without any decline
tasks.correct_answer: More than 32% over several weeks, including 14% on the previous Friday
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת ירידה של יותר מ־32% במשך כמה שבועות, כולל 14% ביום שישי.

tasks.prompt: Explain why public concern about AI makes Trump's support for Nvidia politically risky.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין דרישות להגבלות על מרכזי נתונים, חשש מהפרעה כלכלית וחברתית, התנגדות בבסיס הכפרי והזדהות טראמפ עם תעשיית ה־AI.
expected_points: Candidates from both political sides called for restrictions and legal guardrails.
Communities worry about data centres' demands on local resources and infrastructure.
Trump has positioned himself as a major supporter of AI growth.
If those concerns deepen, his close association with Nvidia may create political costs.

tasks.prompt: What conflict-of-interest concern does the article raise about Trump's role?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שטראמפ התערב בהחלטות של חברה פרטית גדולה בעודו מחזיק במניות בשווי מיליוני דולרים, בתקופה שבה שחיתות הייתה נושא מרכזי לבוחרים.
expected_points: Trump intervened in the deliberations of a major private company.
He owns millions of dollars of stock in the company.
Polling showed political corruption was a leading voter concern.
The intervention may strengthen perceptions that powerful people receive special treatment.

tasks.prompt: Write 4–5 sentences analysing why Trump may have judged the intervention worth the risk.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את חשיבות הכלכלה למורשתו, תרומת השקעות AI לצמיחה, מרכזיות Nvidia וחשש מקריסת בועה שתפגע בשווקים ובנשיאותו.
expected_points: Trump treats economic performance as central to his political legacy.
Recent US growth has depended heavily on AI investment.
Nvidia sits at the centre of the American AI industry.
Its sharp decline also pulled down major stock indices.
Trump may have intervened to prevent an AI-led market crash with broad political consequences.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article's case that Trump's intervention may have delayed rather than solved a crisis.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את החזרת חואנג והעלייה הראשונית, החקירות האפשריות, החששות הציבוריים והפוליטיים, הירידות בשוק והיחלשות העלייה ביום שלאחר מכן.
expected_points: Trump helped restore Huang and Nvidia's stock initially rebounded.
Congressional and possible state investigations could still produce damaging findings.
Public scepticism about AI and corruption creates continuing political risk.
Nvidia and major indices had already suffered steep losses.
The stock surrendered much of its rebound the next day, leaving the wider AI and economic outlook unresolved.
